rounds.title: Breadcrumb baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK breadcrumb (et-breadcrumb), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: a short trail (Home, Competitions, the current page) and a long trail collapsed by etBreadcrumbCollapse (Home, the ellipsis overflow trigger, the current page), with link hover, active and focus-visible, the current page under a forced hover (draws nothing, as expected), overflow trigger hover, active and focus-visible, and the open overflow toggletip listing the four hidden crumbs. The breadcrumb has no variants, sizes, colour inputs or icon slot (a crumb renders whatever its template holds), so no icon crumb is drawn. Fixed numbers: link crumbs in the muted surface text 7.81:1 light, 6.94:1 dark; the current page in the full text at weight 500, 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark; a hovered link turns to the full text with a 1px underline, 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark; a pressed link has no look of its own (stays at 7.81:1 / 6.94:1); the chevron separator in the subtle surface text, about 4.95:1 light, 4.99:1 dark (a 1.5px stroke, measured at its darkest pixel); the ellipsis in the overflow trigger 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark; overflow list rows 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark. Edges and fills, numbers only (Q98 pane edges and Q101 hover fill steps are open): the overflow toggletip pane edge 1.26:1 against the page light, 1.73:1 dark; the trigger hover fill 1.14:1 light, 1.18:1 dark, active 1.40:1 light, 1.60:1 dark, the focus-visible fill 1.23:1 light, 1.34:1 dark. Today the link focus outline fails on light: the 2px primary mint, 1.33:1 against the page (dark 13.50:1). The overflow trigger ring takes the surface theme's primary, a grey, 10.37:1 light, 13.07:1 dark. Not this round's question: the pane edge and fills (Q98, Q101); that a pressed link has no look; the chevron and muted-link colours; the toggletip panel's own focus ring (primary, not drawn). The host's overflow: hidden used to clip every focus outline in the trail; the lib fix 485a509f3 gives the rings room, so both variants show them in full. Variant b applies only decided rule Q88 (focus outlines in --et-theme-color-ink-solid, on the link and on the overflow trigger); Q99 rule a has no other target here (no mint edge, dot, text or fill), and the round adds no edge, so Q102 does not arise. Variant a shows today.

a.note: Today: the link focus outline is the 2px primary mint, 1.33:1 against the light page (dark 13.50:1), under the 3:1 of WCAG 1.4.11 in light; the overflow trigger ring is the surface theme primary, 10.37:1 light, 13.07:1 dark. Text, separators and fills as in the round note.

b.note: Pick. Decided rule Q88, not a new call: focus outlines in --et-theme-color-ink-solid. The link ring is 5.48:1 against the light page; in dark the ink is the mint, so dark is unchanged at 13.50:1. The overflow trigger ring takes the surface theme's ink, 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark (from 10.37:1 and 13.07:1). Nothing else changes; no edge is added, so Q102 does not apply. Fills and pane edge as in a (Q98, Q101 open).
